note: Independent charging/discharging illustrations, not a continuous captured session. TX requests are documented commands; RX values and unverified trailers are synthetic.

sessions.title: BlackVue B-124, firmware 1.44
sessions.notes: Match B-124 and revision 144 before decoding the classic status layout. Output current can be positive during charging.

sessions.title: BlackVue B-130A, firmware 1.61
sessions.notes: Match B-130A and revision 161; use extended voltage offsets 23/25. Zero output current while input is powered does not establish zero attached-load consumption.

sessions.title: BlackVue B-130X, firmware 1.61
sessions.notes: Match B-130X and revision 161 separately from B-130A. State 0/zero current can coexist with output voltage. Charging-mode zero discharge current does not prove that a camera is off.

sessions.title: BlackboxMyCar BI-750, firmware 1.6
sessions.write_mode: write with response in the upstream implementation; inspect actual properties
sessions.notes: Word 32 identifies model/firmware. Cycle 33/34/35 and timestamp groups separately; they are not an atomic snapshot. Raw mode 4 is not a complete state specification. Raw mode 0 plus zero input and positive output supports discharging; zero charging-mode output current does not establish zero camera consumption.

sessions.title: Cellink Neo, firmware 1.52
sessions.notes: The product is Cellink Neo; its returned six-byte identity is Neo 6. Require revision 152 and use classic voltage offsets 11/12, not the B-130 extended map. This charging illustration has no output load. State 0/zero runtime with no load does not indicate an empty battery. Shared telemetry does not authorize BlackVue configuration commands.

sessions.title: BlackboxMyCar PowerCell 8, F141
sessions.notes: Charging state 1 is source-derived and NOT hardware-verified on F141; this fixture illustrates the documented branch, not accepted charging support. Discharging state 2 is hardware-observed. Require PWC8 identity before status. Use the six-byte requests on FF12, not the separately present FFF0 service; LF then CR terminates frames. Settings PIN and reserved fields are zeroed, not real credentials.

sessions.title: VIOFO BP100, V39
sessions.write_mode: write with response where supported; observed writer also supports no-response
sessions.notes: GET_MODE must return positive firmware and application mode 16 before 01-04; boot mode 1 is not ready. The charging bit is command-01 payload bit 7, not the same enumeration as BlackVue or PC8. Current fractions differ: input p2/10+p3, output p2/100+p3. Outgoing CRC is XMODEM; native sessions skip incoming CRC verification. No UID/binding mutation is part of these exchanges.
